principal_results: The preserved NKCC assay is an initial uptake experiment under bicarbonate-free, carbonic-anhydrase-inhibited and CaCC-inhibited conditions and provides no numerical equivalence tolerance.

The frozen sustained zero-storage CBM cannot faithfully encode that transient assay without new dynamics and inhibitor-specific assumptions, so the assay remains a qualitative protocol-specific diagnostic.
No evidence-supported cross-genotype numerical constraint removes the H03 KO J=1 witness at H04.
